status: Original generation archive; all ten refined variants are installed in both apps. See refinement-manifest.json.

options.name: Grand Line Vellum
options.description: Closest to the original, with finer coastal drawing.
options.direction: Refine the established warm original nautical map. Pale honey vellum with unusually delicate sepia copperplate islands, softly desaturated blue-gray stylized cloud curls, dramatic slender rocky island towers in the top-right and lower-right. One small exquisite eight-point compass rose at the right middle. Refined faint rhumb lines at the outer edges. Restrained, balanced, sophisticated, closest to a beautifully restored explorer's atlas.
options.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: standalone landscape background texture for Nika's Chronicle, a professional One Piece inspired stopwatch app.
Create ONE complete landscape image, approximately 1536 x 1024, edge-to-edge flat artwork. This is only the parchment workspace background, not a UI mockup.
Shared visual language: beautiful golden sand and warm yellow-brown aged vellum, delicate hand-drawn nautical cartography, faded sepia engraving and exceptionally subtle watercolor. Warm mid-light parchment throughout, never white. Fine natural paper fibers, restrained mottling, polished and carefully composed, no dirty stains or dark burnt edges.
Composition required by the real app: the central 65% and much of the left side must remain softly textured open parchment for large navy timer digits and controls. Interesting map details cluster along the outer right 20%, upper-right corner, and lower-right corner; a few tiny faint cloud or coastline traces may enter along the left edge. Art should fade organically into the central field rather than end at a rectangle. Open space should feel naturally integrated, not a glowing blank hole.
Any compass rose must be perfectly circular, modest size, lightly drawn near the right edge. Fine cartographic lines must remain faint and elegant. Islands should feel like whimsical One Piece adventure-world map illustrations, not realistic satellite terrain.
No interface, no timer, no buttons, no mockup frame, no borders, no sidebar, no title, no labels, no text, no lettering, no numbers, no watermark, no characters, no pirate skulls, no big emblems, no 3D Log Pose object. Do not add legible writing or a central compass.

options.name: Amber Voyage
options.description: Deeper honey parchment and antique bronze ink.
options.direction: A richer amber atlas with toasted honey parchment and antique bronze ink. Use finely engraved archipelagos with stepped rocky silhouettes, subtle pearl-gray cloud accents, two very faint dotted sailing routes skirting the right margin, a small precisely circular sixteen-point compass in the upper-right third. Center stays lighter warm golden sand, never cream-white. Luxurious aged atlas without ornament clutter.

options.name: Sky Island Chart
options.description: Cloud islands and airy, faded contours.
options.direction: A Skypiea inspired sky-sea explorer chart. Warm pale ochre paper with light honey undertones. Delicate islands resting in soft rounded cloud banks on the upper-right and lower-right, tiny ancient stepped ruins barely visible on one island, restrained faded slate-blue cloud hatching. A fine, small celestial navigation rose with thin circular rings near the far right. Airy and graceful; almost all drawing is confined to right edges, not center. No large sun, giant ring, or landscape horizon.

options.name: Lagoon Cartography
options.description: Warm sand with a restrained sea-glass wash.
options.direction: A Water Seven inspired lagoon chart. Warm sand parchment with fine antique sepia penwork and tiny restrained sea-glass teal watercolor only inside the outer-right harbor and canal diagrams. Small island port silhouettes, arched waterways and pale concentric tidal contour lines along the right edge, all appearing as antique illustrative cartography rather than a realistic city scene. Center is entirely warm parchment. Small faded wind rose in lower-right. Elegant maritime craftsmanship, no saturated blue ocean.

options.name: Wano Ink Atlas
options.description: Soft woodblock waves and mountain contours.

options.name: Desert Kingdom
options.description: Saffron sand, ancient coastlines, distant ruins.
options.direction: An Alabasta inspired ancient desert kingdom sea chart. Soft saffron-sand parchment, elegant pale umber contours, a fine coastline along the far-right edge containing tiny sandstone palace towers and weathered ruin symbols, very delicate dune hatching. Quiet, sun-warmed, refined, slightly drier and more golden than standard map, no enormous monuments or heavy texture.

options.description: The most precise and understated nautical chart.
options.direction: A master navigator's exquisite antique Grand Line chart. Balanced warm wheat-gold vellum, ultra-fine faded copperplate coastlines and topographic island contours at the right perimeter, tiny stylized jagged One Piece islands in lower-right and top-right. Museum-quality restrained craftsmanship and subtly embossed ink feel, not glossy gold. Quiet central parchment, the most mature and minimal of the set while visibly retaining fantasy nautical adventure character.
